The invention relates to a device (1) for labeling individual products (2), comprising an advancing device (3) for transporting each product (2) in a transport direction (X), a label dispensing device (4) for dispensing a label, which can be removed from a material strip (5), from a discharge point (6) in a dispensing direction (S), and a label transporting device (7) with a movable label transporting means (8) for transporting the dispensed label (5) from a transfer region (9), where the dispensed label (5) is transferred to the label transporting mean (8), to a delivery point (10), where the label (5) is applied onto the respective product (2). The label transport means (8) has a surface (11) which is brought into contact with the label (5). The aim of the invention is to simplify the labeling of individual products (2) and apply the labels (5) as precisely as possible. According to the invention, this is achieved in that the device (1) additionally has a label aligning device (12) with a roller (13) which has a roller axis (14) that is parallel to the surface (11) of the label transporting means (8) and a lateral surface (15) that is arranged circumferentially about the roller axis (14). The roller (13) is arranged such that an imaginary straight line (G) running from the discharge point (6) in the dispensing direction (S) intersects the lateral surface (15). The invention further relates to a corresponding method for labeling individual products (2).

The invention concerns an apparatus (1) for applying labels to separate products (2). The apparatus includes a conveying unit (3) that moves each product (2) along a transport direction (X), and a label dispensing unit (4) that releases a label, detachable from a material web (5), from an output location (6) in a dispensing direction (S). It also includes a label transfer unit (7) having a movable label carrier element (8), which carries the dispensed label (5) from a handover area (9), where the label (5) is passed onto the label carrier element (8), to an application location (10), where the label (5) is placed on the corresponding product (2). The label carrier element (8) includes a surface (11) intended to come into contact with the label (5).

The purpose of the invention is to make the labeling of individual products (2) easier while positioning the labels (5) with the greatest possible accuracy. This is accomplished by providing the apparatus (1) with an additional label orientation unit (12). This unit has a roller (13) with a roller axis (14) extending parallel to the surface (11) of the label carrier element (8), and with an outer circumferential surface (15) surrounding the roller axis (14). The invention relates to a device for labeling individual products that are transported in a predetermined transport direction. The device is designed to apply labels accurately and reliably to products as they move past a labeling station.

The device includes a label dispensing unit configured to dispense individual labels from a material strip. The labels are separated from the strip and made available at a discharge point. From this discharge point, each label is transferred to a label transporting device.

The label transporting device receives the dispensed label in a transfer region and moves it to a delivery point. At the delivery point, the label is applied to the respective product. During this movement, the label is supported and carried by a surface of the label transporting means. This surface contacts the label and ensures that it remains in position while being transported from the transfer region to the product.

To improve the accuracy of the labeling process, the invention further provides a label aligning device. This aligning device includes a roller arranged so that it intersects the label dispensing path. As a label is dispensed, the roller acts on the label and influences its position before or during transfer to the label transporting device. In this way, the label can be aligned more precisely with respect to the transport path and the product to be labeled.

By adding the label aligning device with the intersecting roller, the invention improves the positional accuracy of the label before application. This results in more precise label placement on the products and reduces the risk of misalignment during high-speed labeling operations.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a labeling apparatus and method for applying labels to individual products in a precise, reliable, and simplified manner. The apparatus includes a transport system for conveying products successively through a labeling station, a label dispenser for dispensing individual labels from a label supply, and label transporting means for guiding and transferring each dispensed label toward the product to be labeled.

To improve the accuracy with which each label is positioned before being applied, the apparatus further includes a label aligning device. This label aligning device comprises at least one roller arranged in a defined position relative to the dispensing path of the label. The roller is positioned such that the path followed by a label after being dispensed intersects the lateral surface of the roller. As a result, the label comes into contact with the roller during transport and is guided, aligned, or corrected in its orientation before reaching the product.

This arrangement enables the label to be stabilized and accurately positioned prior to application. In particular, any deviation in the lateral or angular alignment of the label can be reduced as the label is transported past the roller. The label therefore reaches the application region in a more controlled orientation, allowing it to be placed on the product with improved precision.

The invention is especially useful in systems where products are transported continuously or intermittently and where labels must be applied at high speed while maintaining consistent placement accuracy. By incorporating the roller-based aligning device into the label dispensing path, the apparatus achieves accurate label positioning without requiring complex control mechanisms or extensive adjustment procedures. This simplifies the overall construction of the labeling apparatus while increasing the reliability of the labeling process.

In operation, a product is conveyed by the transport system toward the labeling station. At the appropriate time, the label dispenser releases a label, which is taken over by the label transporting means. As the label moves along its dispensing path, it encounters the lateral surface of the roller of the label aligning device. The interaction between the label and the roller causes the label to assume a desired position and orientation. The aligned label is then conveyed further and applied to the product at the intended location.

By ensuring that the dispensed label path intersects the lateral surface of the roller, the invention provides a simple mechanical solution for improving label alignment. This leads to more accurate placement of labels on individual products, reduces mislabeling, and enhances the consistency and quality of the finished labeled products.

**According** to grammar rules, words like “the” may seem small, but they play a powerful role in communication. They help readers understand exactly what is being discussed. The meaning of a sentence can change depending on whether “the” is included or left out.

In short, the word **“the”** and the phrase **“according to”** both help make language more precise. The first identifies something specific, while the second shows the source of information or opinion. Together, they remind us that even simple words can have great importance in clear writing.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for an invention involving a device for labeling individual products, including an advancing device, label dispensing device, label transport means, and a roller-based label aligning device.
counterfactuals.output: A device for labeling individual products comprises an advancing device configured to move the products along a transport path, a label dispensing device configured to dispense labels, and label transport means arranged to receive labels from the label dispensing device and deliver the labels toward the products. The device further comprises a label aligning device disposed along the label transport means and including at least one roller configured to contact a label being transported. The roller is arranged to influence the position and/or orientation of the label relative to the label transport means, thereby aligning the label before application to a corresponding product. The label aligning device may include one or more driven or freely rotatable rollers positioned to correct lateral displacement, skew, or angular misalignment of the label. By aligning the labels during transport, the device enables accurate placement of labels on individual products moving through the labeling device.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

More particularly, the invention relates to a labelling machine comprising a dispensing arrangement for separating labels from the material strip and transferring the separated labels onto respective products, wherein an alignment roller is arranged to act on the material strip, the labels and/or the products in order to improve the positional alignment of the labels relative to the products during transfer. counterfactuals.prompt: Create a German-to-English patent translation-style description of an invention for labeling individual products, using reference numerals for all parts and explaining that the goal is to simplify labeling and improve precision.
counterfactuals.output:
**Description**

The invention relates to an apparatus **(1)** and a method for labeling individual products **(2)**, in particular products **(2)** conveyed separately or at irregular intervals on a transport device **(3)**. The invention has the object of simplifying the labeling of individual products **(2)** and of improving the precision with which a label **(4)** is applied to the respective product **(2)**.

The apparatus **(1)** comprises a transport device **(3)** for transporting the products **(2)** in a conveying direction **(F)**. The transport device **(3)** may be configured, for example, as a conveyor belt, roller conveyor, chain conveyor, or as another suitable conveying unit. Each product **(2)** is guided through a labeling station **(5)**, in which a label **(4)** is applied to the product **(2)**.

A label supply unit **(6)** is arranged in the region of the labeling station **(5)**. The label supply unit **(6)** comprises a label carrier strip **(7)** on which a plurality of labels **(4)** are arranged. The label carrier strip **(7)** is guided over a dispensing edge **(8)**, by means of which the respective label **(4)** is separated from the label carrier strip **(7)** and made available for application to the product **(2)**.

For detecting the position of the product **(2)**, the apparatus **(1)** comprises at least one sensor **(9)**. The sensor **(9)** is configured to detect a leading edge **(10)**, a trailing edge **(11)**, a side face **(12)**, or another reference region of the product **(2)**. The sensor **(9)** transmits a detection signal to a control unit **(13)**. On the basis of the detection signal, the control unit **(13)** determines the exact application time and/or the exact application position for the label **(4)**.

The apparatus **(1)** further comprises an applicator **(14)**, which applies the label **(4)** to the product **(2)**. The applicator **(14)** may be formed as a tamping device, a blowing device, a rolling device, a pivoting arm, or as a combined tamping-and-blowing device. In a preferred embodiment, the applicator **(14)** is movable in an application direction **(A)** toward the product **(2)** and away from the product **(2)**. The movement of the applicator **(14)** is controlled by the control unit **(13)**.

In order to improve the precision of labeling, a position correction device **(15)** is provided. The position correction device **(15)** may comprise an adjustable guide **(16)** for the product **(2)**, an adjustable mounting **(17)** for the applicator **(14)**, or an electronically controlled drive **(18)** for adapting the relative position between the label **(4)** and the product **(2)**. By means of the position correction device **(15)**, deviations in the position, size, or orientation of the product **(2)** can be compensated before or during application of the label **(4)**.

The control unit **(13)** is preferably connected to the sensor **(9)**, the label supply unit **(6)**, the applicator **(14)**, and the position correction device **(15)**. The control unit **(13)** may store product data **(19)** and label data **(20)**. The product data **(19)** may include the dimensions, shape, conveying speed, and desired label position of the product **(2)**. The label data **(20)** may include the size, spacing, printing information, and orientation of the labels **(4)**. By comparing the product data **(19)** with the detected position of the product **(2)**, the control unit **(13)** can control the application process with high accuracy.

In operation, a product **(2)** is transported by the transport device **(3)** in the conveying direction **(F)** toward the labeling station **(5)**. The sensor **(9)** detects the product **(2)** and transmits the detection signal to the control unit **(13)**. The control unit **(13)** calculates the application moment and actuates the label supply unit **(6)** so that a label **(4)** is dispensed from the label carrier strip **(7)** at the dispensing edge **(8)**. The applicator **(14)** then applies the label **(4)** to the predetermined application region **(21)** of the product **(2)**.

Since the movement of the applicator **(14)** and the dispensing of the label **(4)** are coordinated with the detected position of the individual product **(2)**, the label **(4)** can be applied precisely even when the spacing between successive products **(2)** varies. This makes it possible to label individual products **(2)** without requiring complex mechanical adjustment or manual alignment.

The invention therefore provides a labeling apparatus **(1)** by means of which the labeling process is simplified. At the same time, the accuracy of the label position on the product **(2)** is improved. In particular, the apparatus **(1)** permits reliable labeling of individually supplied products **(2)**, products **(2)** of different sizes, and products **(2)** conveyed at variable distances from one another.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
